query: select bucket_id, metadata->>'cacheControl' as cache_control, case when name like '%/playback/%' then 'playback-path' when name like '%preview%' then 'preview-named' else 'other' end as path_class, count(*)::int as objects, sum((metadata->>'size')::bigint)::text as bytes from storage.objects where bucket_id in ('generated_images','generated_videos') and metadata->>'cacheControl'='max-age=31536000' group by bucket_id,metadata->>'cacheControl',path_class order by bucket_id,path_class;
